# calendar-task-suggester


Read Google Calendar event notes and suggest actionable project tasks with contextual reasoning.



## Triggers

- calendar notes

- suggest tasks

- read my calendar

- calendar tasks

- sugerir tareas desde calendario

- leer notas del calendario

- task suggestions from calendar




## What I do

- Retrieve Google Calendar events within a configurable date range

- Analyze event descriptions for actionable language, TODOs, and project keywords

- Rank task suggestions by estimated relevance (High / Medium / Low)

- Output a structured markdown report of suggested tasks




## Usage examples

- Suggest tasks from my calendar

- Read my calendar notes and suggest tasks

- Sugerir tareas desde mi calendario
